name: replication_stage_2
selection_policy: Descriptive sensitivity analysis of every declared setting. No parameter is selected using these labels for an independent validation claim. Resource measurements use the previously fixed ngram=3, top_k=10, indexing=right baseline.

resources.order: Each block shuffles dataset-stage jobs, executes them sequentially, and uses a fresh process per job.
resources.memory: Peak process RSS from resource.getrusage, including interpreter, imports and input loading. Scheduling workers load a common candidate snapshot; candidate workers load source CSVs. No claim of incremental algorithm-only memory.
